title: Appraisal Order Complexity Add-On: Market-Value Part
content:
## Market-value part of the Appraisal Order complexity add-on

The market-value part of the complexity add-on reads the property value on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports: a property value of 1,500,000 dollars or more adds 200 dollars, a property value of 1,000,000 to 1,499,999.99 dollars adds 125 dollars, and a lower property value adds nothing. The market-value part is added into the add-on subtotal of the complexity add-on.

| Property value on the Mortgage Loan File (USD) | Market-value part (USD) |
|---|---|
| 1500000.00 or more | 200.00 |
| 1000000.00 to 1499999.99 | 125.00 |
| Under 1000000.00 | 0.00 |

**Boundary readings (hypothetical values).**

| Property value | Band | Adds |
|---|---|---|
| 999,999.99 | Under 1,000,000 | Nothing |
| 1,000,000.00 | 1,000,000 to 1,499,999.99 | 125.00 |
| 1,499,999.99 | 1,000,000 to 1,499,999.99 | 125.00 |
| 1,500,000.00 | 1,500,000 or more | 200.00 |

The value read is the property value recorded on the Mortgage Loan File the Appraisal Order supports.
